fast.why: Monday is the day deeds are presented to Allah and the day the Prophet ﷺ was born. Intend the night before; today is Jumaat, so don't single out Friday alone for fasting.

blessing: Time to pause on a Friday: Jumaat is the best day of the week and a built-in reset. Today, be early to the masjid, send extra selawat, and thank Allah for the chance to rest your mind.

verse.text: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

hadith.text: No calamity befalls a Muslim but Allah expiates some of his sins because of it, even if it is the prick he receives from a thorn.

lesson.title: Fiqh of solat: praying in congregation
lesson.text: The Prophet ﷺ said the prayer in congregation is 27 degrees better than praying alone. In the Shafi'i school it is a strongly emphasised sunnah (for Jumaat it is obligatory for men). Even a small jemaah at work or at a surau counts. Practise: try one fard prayer in jemaah today, and go early for Jumaat.

name.text: "Do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins" (39:53). Mistakes at work are not the end; make istighfar today and move on lighter.
"Sufficient is your Lord as a Guide and Helper" (25:31). Ask Him tonight for guidance on your next career step.

world.text: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists set it at 85 seconds to midnight on 27 Jan 2026, the closest ever, citing nuclear risk, AI and great-power rivalry.
Forecasters' chance of a 'World War Three' before 2050 (10M+ deaths, major powers involved).
Prof Jiang's latest lectures on geopolitics and where great-power conflict is heading.

Nuclear deterrence makes all-out war a losing move for every major power, so the stable outcome (flashing) is 'compete, don't fight': trade wars, arms races and proxy conflicts. The real danger is a misread in a crisis like Taiwan or Ukraine, which is why the clock and the forecast are rising. Meter: 2 of 5.
